relations: Advancing dark cloud edges intermittently narrow and widen the central sun-glow patch.
Fine continuous water ripples cause the vertical golden reflection to shimmer and wiggle in texture.
A fixed camera position keeps the dark silhouetted shoreline and port cranes locked relative to the frame.
The small dark cloud blob below the sun continually changes outline as surrounding masses shift.
caption: The video captures a low sun glowing through a gap in a heavy, broken cloud layer over calm water, framed by a dark silhouetted shoreline with blocky structures on the left and port cranes on the right. A vertical golden reflection column falls from the bright gap onto the rippling surface below. The camera holds a fixed position, so the horizon and all silhouettes stay locked in place relative to the frame edges throughout. The visible motion lies in the sky and the water. The large dark central cloud mass slowly drifts and deforms, its edges reshaping as it moves. The bright sun-glow patch near the center is intermittently narrowed and widened by these advancing cloud edges. A small dark cloud blob below the sun's core persists but continually changes outline as surrounding masses shift. The water keeps up a fine continuous ripple, making the golden reflection shimmer and wiggle in texture without translating as a whole. This cloud drift and surface shimmer are already underway on the first frame and continue through the last.
